_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail on the pattern of the Purpur egg: Arclight's launcher jar from its GitHub releases (IzzelAliz/Arclight) for NeoForge, Forge or Fabric, checked against the SHA-256 GitHub lists for the file, or for older files without one against the SHA-256 Octail recorded on 2026-10-13 (any other file without a checksum is refused); latest is the newest stable release for the loader, snapshots only on the snapshot channel or by tag. A hybrid (mods and Bukkit plugins): the Minecraft tools without the version changer or modpacks. The eula flag (the panel asks the owner on the first start, nothing is pre-accepted), Java 21 to 8 images, Minecraft Java idle sleep, install sandbox defaults and resource hints.
name: Arclight
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Arclight is a hybrid Minecraft Java server: Bukkit on top of NeoForge, Forge or Fabric, so it runs that loader's mods and Bukkit/Spigot plugins on one server.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Arclight installation (Octail): the server jar from Arclight's GitHub releases (IzzelAliz/Arclight), its
# SHA-256 checked. A version, loader or release that doesn't exist fails the install instead of silently
# installing another one.
#
# Arclight is Bukkit (CraftBukkit/Spigot) on top of NeoForge, Forge or Fabric: it runs that loader's mods
# (mods/) and Bukkit plugins (plugins/). The jar is Arclight's launcher: on the first start it downloads the
# loader's libraries and the Minecraft server, so the first start takes a few minutes.
#
# Checksums: GitHub lists a SHA-256 (`digest`) for release files uploaded since mid-2025 (Arclight 1.21.1
# FeudalKings/1.0.1 and newer). Older releases have none, and Arclight publishes none of its own, so this
# script carries the SHA-256 of the newest stable file per Minecraft version and loader, as Octail downloaded
# them on 2026-10-13. Any other file without a digest is refused.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -eu

REPO=https://api.github.com/repos/IzzelAliz/Arclight
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
LOADER="${ARCLIGHT_LOADER:-neoforge}"
RELEASE="${ARCLIGHT_RELEASE:-latest}"
CHANNEL="${ARCLIGHT_CHANNEL:-stable}"

fail() {
	echo "Install failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 120 -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' "$1"; }

# SHA-256 of release files GitHub has no digest for (downloaded and hashed by Octail on 2026-10-13).
pinned_sha256() {
	case "$1" in
	arclight-forge-1.16.5-1.0.25.jar) echo 0711487fb8d624bd89bd74e8bab271c8befb96485282de5ccc6fd85cf9a40f98 ;;
	arclight-forge-1.18.2-1.0.12.jar) echo c3287b2a9553db80952e243dece2f8aba37261544c771e1777a1ee3ff5b7829f ;;
	arclight-forge-1.19.2-1.0.5.jar) echo bc964d4c4a414f4ebbf24404a0faa35a46c834ec440942773f9c65ff9374a612 ;;
	arclight-forge-1.19.4-1.0.8.jar) echo 8d61ea8f0ea5d27e0eb9ebed964df6fdcea163745d4cfcceea3273ba5b73841c ;;
	arclight-forge-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar) echo 40132f12fee21b4487cc995bb00b91b358df4b8162a48e98127a0368cf7e8c91 ;;
	arclight-forge-1.20.2-1.0.3.jar) echo abbc4c50973c1f4ecc0c9600e53c4f1b5484e0e6555d73075c20b65f0b1543c4 ;;
	arclight-forge-1.20.4-1.0.4-80ec5df.jar) echo ac5594dbad82c2f31828cf2db83f162e91a6cd205583ee81f684d423c70ad4e1 ;;
	arclight-neoforge-1.20.4-1.0.4-80ec5df.jar) echo 9c39f1e713ed5bae3bbbb7d77a5c6c7b9586a7adc539ed7812e2fc890a76a137 ;;
	arclight-fabric-1.20.4-1.0.4-80ec5df.jar) echo 7f717a1fe4e30ee53671540f09142808efced1ef19f5d68219afa458e048ebf5 ;;
	esac
}

case "${LOADER}" in
neoforge | forge | fabric) ;;
*) fail "the loader (${LOADER}) must be neoforge, forge or fabric" ;;
esac
case "${CHANNEL}" in
stable | snapshot) ;;
*) fail "the channel (${CHANNEL}) must be stable or snapshot" ;;
esac
case "${VERSION}" in
latest | [0-9]*.[0-9]*) ;;
*) fail "the Minecraft version (${VERSION}) must be a release such as 1.21.1, or latest" ;;
esac

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Every release (newest first). Arclight has fewer than 100 a page; up to three pages are read.
RELEASES='[]'
for PAGE in 1 2 3; do
	BATCH=$(get "${REPO}/releases?per_page=100&page=${PAGE}") ||
		fail "can't list Arclight's releases on GitHub (${REPO}/releases). GitHub allows 60 API calls an hour per address: try again later."
	RELEASES=$(printf '%s\n%s' "${RELEASES}" "${BATCH}" | jq -s 'add')
	[ "$(echo "${BATCH}" | jq 'length')" -eq 100 ] || break
done

# One line per release file: tag, prerelease, file name, download URL, digest. Only arclight-<loader>-<mc>-… jars.
FILES=$(echo "${RELEASES}" | jq -c --arg l "${LOADER}" '
	.[] | {tag: .tag_name, pre: .prerelease, created: .created_at} as $r | .assets[]
	| select(.name | test("^arclight-" + $l + "-[0-9][0-9.]*-.*\\.jar$"))
	| $r + {name, url: .browser_download_url, digest: (.digest // ""),
		mc: (.name | capture("^arclight-[a-z]+-(?<v>[0-9][0-9.]*[0-9])-").v)}')
[ -n "${FILES}" ] || fail "Arclight has no ${LOADER} releases"

if [ "${RELEASE}" != "latest" ]; then
	PICK=$(echo "${FILES}" | jq -sc --arg t "${RELEASE}" 'map(select(.tag == $t)) | .[0] // empty')
	[ -n "${PICK}" ] || fail "Arclight release ${RELEASE} has no ${LOADER} file. The releases are at https://github.com/IzzelAliz/Arclight/releases"
	PICK_MC=$(echo "${PICK}" | jq -r '.mc')
	if [ "${VERSION}" != "latest" ] && [ "${VERSION}" != "${PICK_MC}" ]; then
		fail "Arclight release ${RELEASE} is for Minecraft ${PICK_MC}, not ${VERSION}"
	fi
else
	PICK=$(echo "${FILES}" | jq -sc --arg v "${VERSION}" --arg c "${CHANNEL}" '
		map(select($c == "snapshot" or (.pre | not)))
		| map(select($v == "latest" or .mc == $v))
		| sort_by([(.mc | split(".") | map(tonumber)), .created]) | reverse
		| .[0] // empty')
	if [ -z "${PICK}" ]; then
		HAVE=$(echo "${FILES}" | jq -sr --arg c "${CHANNEL}" 'map(select($c == "snapshot" or (.pre | not)) | .mc) | unique | join(", ")')
		HINT=""
		[ "${CHANNEL}" = "snapshot" ] || HINT=" Snapshot builds need the channel set to snapshot."
		fail "Arclight has no ${CHANNEL} ${LOADER} release for Minecraft ${VERSION}. ${CHANNEL} ${LOADER} releases exist for: ${HAVE:-none}.${HINT}"
	fi
fi

TAG=$(echo "${PICK}" | jq -r '.tag')
NAME=$(echo "${PICK}" | jq -r '.name')
URL=$(echo "${PICK}" | jq -r '.url')
MC=$(echo "${PICK}" | jq -r '.mc')
case "${URL}" in
https://github.com/IzzelAliz/Arclight/releases/download/*) ;;
*) fail "unexpected download address for ${NAME}: ${URL}" ;;
esac
SHA=$(echo "${PICK}" | jq -r '.digest | ltrimstr("sha256:")' | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')
FROM="GitHub's digest"
if [ -z "${SHA}" ]; then
	SHA=$(pinned_sha256 "${NAME}")
	FROM="the SHA-256 Octail recorded"
fi
echo "${SHA}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' ||
	fail "${NAME} (release ${TAG}) has no checksum: GitHub lists no digest for it and Octail has none recorded. Pick a newer release."

echo "Installing Arclight ${LOADER} for Minecraft ${MC}, release ${TAG} (${NAME}) as ${JAR}"
rm -f "${JAR}.download"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 600 -o "${JAR}.download" "${URL}" ||
	fail "the download of ${NAME} failed"
GOT=$(sha256sum "${JAR}.download" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if [ "${GOT}" != "${SHA}" ]; then
	rm -f "${JAR}.download"
	fail "SHA-256 mismatch for ${NAME} (expected ${SHA}, got ${GOT})"
fi
if [ -f "${JAR}" ]; then
	mv -f "${JAR}" "${JAR}.old"
fi
mv "${JAR}.download" "${JAR}"
mkdir -p mods plugins

echo "Arclight ${LOADER} ${MC} (${TAG}) installed, SHA-256 checked against ${FROM}. ${LOADER} mods go in mods/, Bukkit plugins in plugins/."
echo "The first start downloads the loader's libraries and the Minecraft server, which takes a few minutes."
echo "Accepting the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA) is the server owner's decision: the panel asks on the first start."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description:
The Minecraft version to install, such as 1.21.1, or latest for the newest one Arclight has a release for on the loader and channel. A version without one fails the install.

The Startup image must fit it: Java 21 for 1.20.5 and newer, Java 17 for 1.18 to 1.20.4, Java 8 or 11 for 1.16.5.

variables.name: Loader
variables.description: The mod loader under Arclight: neoforge, forge or fabric. Mods must be for this loader. Not every Minecraft version has all three (1.21.1 and 1.20.4 do; older ones are Forge only).

variables.name: Channel
variables.description: stable for Arclight's releases, snapshot to also take its snapshot builds (pre-releases, such as the first builds for a new Minecraft version).

variables.name: Release
variables.description: A GitHub release tag to install, such as FeudalKings/1.0.1, or latest for the newest release that fits the version, loader and channel.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jar file (Arclight's launcher).
